biography: Sergio Zamprogna, a name now whispered with anticipation in the Brazilian racing scene, didn't come from motorsport royalty. Born in the bustling favelas of São Paulo, his earliest memories aren't of roaring engines, but of the rhythmic clang of his father's autobody shop. Sergio learned to love metal there, coaxing it back to life, an unlikely precursor to his finesse on the track. His karting career began late, funded by his mother's tireless work as a seamstress and Sergio's own after-school shifts. A defining moment came during the regional karting championship in 2018, where a daring last-lap overtake, executed with breathtaking precision, caught the eye of a Puma P052 scout. Now, at 26, Sergio is a rising star in the P052 development program, balancing raw talent with a hunger to prove himself worthy of every opportunity.
drivingStyle: Zamprogna's driving style is as flamboyant as his personality. He's known for late braking and aggressive corner entries, often pushing the limits of grip to gain an advantage. While his tire management needs refinement, his innate ability to find speed and his unwavering confidence under pressure make him a formidable opponent, especially on street circuits where his daring maneuvers can pay off handsomely. He thrives in chaotic conditions, displaying a remarkable ability to anticipate and react to sudden changes on the track.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry dating back to their karting days. Bellini, a product of a wealthy racing family, has always dismissed Zamprogna as 'uncouth,' fueling a fierce competitive spirit between them.
A recent clash stemming from an on-track incident during the Brazilian Grand Prix support race. Flores accused Zamprogna of overly aggressive driving, leading to a heated exchange in the paddock.
Tanaka is Sergio's teammate at Puma P052, and the two are constantly trying to one-up each other in practice and qualifying sessions, creating tension within the team.

quirks: Always wears a lucky charm necklace with a miniature wrench his father gave him.
Listens to a specific Brazilian samba song before every race.
Never looks directly at the starting lights, instead focusing on a point slightly to the side.
famousQuote: You can't tame a storm, you just have to learn to dance in the rain. On the track, I am the storm.
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Formula Regional Championship in 2022, securing his spot in the Puma P052 development program. He dominated the season, clinching victory with two races to spare.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 2023 São Paulo Grand Prix support race. The incident cost him a potential podium finish and significant championship points.
